evidence.quote: Select your level of study below to access the Online Application Form.

notes: Tuition: the programme page states 3 000 USD / semester; no EUR/HUF figure is given for this programme, so the stated USD amount is used as-is (minor units 300000). Placement: the two Sopron pages do not say who applies via 'hu-university-direct' for this self-financed programme beyond directing applicants to the university's own Online Application Form, so that quote is used for the channel. The Stipendium Hungaricum availability mentioned by the Studyfinder page is a scholarship covering fees and is not treated as a tuition of 0. Intakes: the only dated intake (February 2027) explicitly excludes Bachelor's programmes, so it is not listed as this programme's intake. Documents: the list is that of the university's English-taught BA/BSc programmes; three items are marked 'Optional' on the page. Requirements: this programme's page does not state a subject list or a prior-study-years minimum; the entrance exam (Skype interview) is covered by a manual_check.

evidence.quote: Language requirements: at least CEFR B2 level (or equivalent TOEFL or IELTS Academic) proficiency in English.

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission oral en ligne (Skype) fait partie de la sélection ; les documents manquants sont signalés et doivent être envoyés.
note.en: An oral online (Skype) admission interview is part of selection; missing documents are flagged and must be sent.

evidence.quote: The entrance exam happens in the frame of a Skype-interview with the participation of the AC.

note.fr: Les documents doivent être en anglais ou en allemand ; sinon une traduction certifiée doit être jointe.
note.en: Documents must be in English or German; otherwise a certified translation must be attached.

evidence.quote: Please ensure all documents are in English or German. If they are in another language, a certified translation must be attached.

note.fr: Les frais de dossier de 150 USD (non remboursables) doivent être payés avant de commencer le formulaire de candidature.
note.en: The 150 USD non-refundable application fee must be paid before starting the online application form.

evidence.quote: Before starting your online form, you must pay the 150 USD non-refundable application fee.

note.fr: Les programmes BSc ne sont pas disponibles pour l'admission de février 2027 ; la date de début indiquée est septembre (pas d'année précisée).
note.en: BSc programmes are not available for the February 2027 intake; the stated starting date is September (no year given).

note.fr: Aucune date limite de candidature datée pour ce programme n'est donnée ; vérifiez le calendrier d'admission sur le site de l'université.
note.en: No dated application deadline for this programme is given; check the admission calendar on the university website.
